title: Single-page Form
description:
## Step 1: Single-page Form

Build a registration form. All fields on one page; on submit, show a summary.

### Requirements
1. Inputs:
   - `<input id="name">` — text
   - `<input id="email">` — type `"email"`
   - `<select id="role">` with options "Designer", "Developer", "PM"
2. `<button id="submit">` — clicking it reveals a summary
3. Summary is a `<div id="summary">` containing the entered name, email, and role (as text)
4. Before submit, the summary should not exist in the DOM
